description: This PHP source file defines a function `displayEmailAddressOptInField` used to generate HTML for email opt-in status based on an Email object. It interacts with email address fields and logging mechanisms, and includes metadata typical of a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM extension.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: Class representing an email object with methods to access email address fields.

methods.name: displayEmailAddressOptInField
